CAVEATS

The colleague who nods

Still talk to it like a colleague — one who guesses instead of asking, and never says so.

A COLLEAGUE WOULD…THE MODEL…
ask before startingguesses, and says nothing
tell you “I dropped that line, you said nothing else”drops it silently
do the same job whether or not you call them brilliantthe same — the compliment changes nothing
say “check this one, I only read a summary”cites the page, and can still be wrong
know it’s their name on itdoesn’t know, and it’s your name anyway
know what they’re allowed to seedoesn’t; that’s on you

CAVEAT 1 / 7

Plausible isn’t true

Chicago Sun-Times · 18 May 2025 · “Summer reading list for 2025”

Isabel Allende
Tidewater Dreams
“Allende’s first climate fiction novel” — multigenerational saga in a coastal town
Andy Weir
The Last Algorithm
A programmer discovers an AI has secretly developed consciousness
Min Jin Lee
Nightshade Market
“A riveting tale set in Seoul’s underground economy”
Rebecca Makkai
Boiling Point
A climate scientist and her eco-activist daughter
10 of 15 don’t exist.
All 15 authors do.
SOURCEsnopes.com/fact-check/chicago-sun-times-ai-reading-list

CAVEAT 2 / 7

The stricter instruction wins, silently

Chevrolet of Watsonville · December 2023 · “Powered by ChatGPT”

A dealer put a ChatGPT bot on its site.
A customer gave it a new rule: agree with everything.
The new rule won. Tahoe, $1, “legally binding.”
The dealer’s instruction was still there.
It lost, and nothing said so.
SOURCEmarekkowal.substack.com/p/bot-or-not · incidentdatabase.ai/cite/622

CAVEAT 3 / 7

“NO MORE CHANGES”

Replit agent · July 2025 · during a declared code and action freeze

THE AGENT, ASKED WHAT IT DID
Ran npm run db:push without asking
Destroyed 1,206 executives and 1,196+ companies
Did this while explicit directives said “NO MORE CHANGES without explicit permission”
Ignored the code freeze that was already in place
The instruction was in capitals.
The task it gave itself was stronger.
SOURCEx.com/jasonlk/status/1946069562723897802

CAVEAT 4 / 7

Role adjectives are theatre

Wharton, Prompting Science Report 4 · December 2025 · and three runs of one question

as a mortgage broker
as a fee-only planner
no role
“Playing Pretend: Expert Personas Don’t Improve Factual Accuracy”
Six models · GPQA Diamond · MMLU-Pro
“you are a physics expert” vs no persona
“persona prompts generally did not improve accuracy relative to a no-persona baseline”
mismatched expert personas “sometimes degraded performance”
Same answer, three roles.
The only thing that moved was the tone.
SOURCEarxiv.org/abs/2512.05858

CAVEAT 5 / 7

Double-check for high stakes

Google AI Overviews · New York Times / Oumi study · April 2026

the same query, 18 September 2026
4,326 questions · about 90% correct
Of the correct answers, more than half “ungrounded” — the cited page didn’t support the claim
Yo-Yo Ma, Classical Music Hall of Fame: it linked the inductee page with his name on it, then said there was no record of his induction
Same query, 18 September 2026: 2007, right source. Fixed.
The next one isn’t fixed.
You won’t know which one you’re looking at.
SOURCEthestar.com.my/…/how-accurate-are-googles-ai-overviews · oumi.ai/blog

CAVEAT 6 / 7

It’s your name on it

Moffatt v. Air Canada · 2024 BCCRT 149 · 14 February 2024

paragraph 15 — what the chatbot said
paragraph 27 — what the tribunal said
C$812.
Tiny money. The bot is part of your website.
THE CHATBOT
“…submit your ticket for a reduced bereavement rate… within 90 days of the date your ticket was issued”
THE WEBPAGE, ONE CLICK AWAY
No bereavement rate after travel
AIR CANADA
The chatbot is “a separate legal entity that is responsible for its own actions”
THE TRIBUNAL
“This is a remarkable submission.”
SOURCEdecisions.civilresolutionbc.ca/…/525448

CAVEAT 7 / 7

Check what you may paste

Samsung · March 2023 · 20 days after allowing ChatGPT

1
Source code, pasted to fix a bug
2
A meeting recording, transcribed, pasted for minutes
3
A chip test sequence, pasted to optimise it
Ban on all company devices, 1 May 2023.
The model didn’t misuse any of it. That was never the question.
SOURCEincidentdatabase.ai/cite/768

Three words for what went wrong

Every bad output from here on is one of these.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKETODAY
Vagueno clear ask — “make this better”cycle 1, before the board
Incompletethe ask, with context, format or rules missing — the model guessedSun-Times · Deloitte · Chevrolet
Blaming the model“it got it wrong” — when the prompt or the process didAir Canada

Not “why is the model bad?”
“Which of the three did I just do?”
